people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

translations.web: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old. His eyes were set, so that he could not see.
translations.bsb: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old, and his gaze was fixed because he could not see.
translations.kjv: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old; and his eyes were dim, that he could not see.
translations.asv: Now Eli was ninety and eight years old; and his eyes were set, so that he could not see.
